messages.content: Help me determine if the system property 'enableXmlSecurityFeature' is set to enable the security feature 'XML_SECURITY' in a Java XML processing environment?

function.name: JdkXmlFeatures_getSystemProperty
function.description: Checks if the specified system property is set and applies its boolean value to the given XML feature. Throws NumberFormatException if the property value is invalid. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

feature.description: The XML feature to check the system property for. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

sysPropertyName.description: The name of the system property to be checked. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning:
The user wants help determining if the system property 'enableXmlSecurityFeature' is set to enable the security feature 'XML_SECURITY' in a Java XML processing environment.

We have a tool `JdkXmlFeatures_getSystemProperty` which checks if the specified system property is set and applies its boolean value to the given XML feature. It throws NumberFormatException if the property value is invalid. We need to call this function with parameters:

- feature: "XML_SECURITY"
- sysPropertyName: "enableXmlSecurityFeature"

Thus we should invoke the function accordingly. According to instructions, calls to tools must go to the commentary channel named 'functions'.

So I will produce a JSON request to the function.
